entities.summary: Patrick Hughes is a British artist working in London. He is the creator of "reverspective", an optical illusion on a three-dimensional surface where the parts of the picture which seem farthest away are actually physically the nearest. Patrick Hughes was a authors & novelists from Birmingham (b. 1939-10-20, Birmingham). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
